data.narrative:
The ePlane Company is a Series B-stage autonomous aircraft developer in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $14M+ and seeking $40–50M in this round. The private comp universe consists of 8 players in drones and autonomous systems, including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation; no public comparables exist in this narrow segment.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable method here. Using total raised ($14M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement yields $27M. This method is grounded in the observable funding step-up pattern within frontier tech, though it relies on the assumption that capital deployment correlates with value creation at this stage.

A peer-median approach is not supportable: while 7 same-sector peers exist, insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable data points preclude a reliable median. Falling back to all-sector medians introduces unacceptable noise given heterogeneity in business models and maturity within autonomous systems.

The triangulation range is $23M (low) to $31M (median $27M), anchored entirely on stage-progression. Key uncertainties include pre-revenue technology risk, regulatory pathway clarity for autonomous aircraft, and capital intensity of commercialization. The tight single-method range should be interpreted cautiously; broader peer data or operational milestones would materially refine this estimate.
